simple.summary: אַדְמָתָא (ʼAdmâthâʼ) means Admatha , a Persian nobleman First listed occurrence: Esth 1 14.

definitions.full: H133. Admatha אַדְמָתָא proper name, masculine a prince of Persia & Media Est 1:14 (compare Persian admâta , unrestrained ). אדן (meaning disputed; (1) compare Assyrian [ adannu ] firm, strong ; adverb adanniš, strongly, exceedingly Dl W > (2) Fü. ( a ) make firm, fasten (compare ) whence אֶדֶן ; ( b ) determine, command, rule , whence אָדוֺן ; ( 3 ) Thes Add., MV and others ( a ) intransitive be under, low, inferior (compare דּוּן , ), whence אֶדֶן ; ( b ) transitive put under command, rule over (compare דִּין ) whence אָדוֺן ; see also (4) Lag M. i. 102 , אָדוֺן from ).
